title: Libre 2plus / 2+ additional sensor life not recognised
body:
Increase in standard sensor life of Libre 2+ from 14 to 15 days is not recognised by xDrip+. Sensor runs for 15.5 days but end of life prediction is incorrect.

xDrip+ was adamant my Libre 2+ sensor would end yesterday at 17:47. It's still running today at 20:49

xDrip says Age 15.1 days and no longer offers me an end time.


_Originally posted by @PhilTU in https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/3833_

I think the Status is it's an open issue awaiting attention. It will require some new logic to differentiate 2 from 2+ sensor.

I don't know whether this will be of any help, but I just wanted to flag up that when using my Libre 1 reader, it determines the correct lifespan for the Libre 2+ sensors. Obviously, I don't know *how* it does that - e.g. whether the sensor lifespan is numerically encoded into a data packet, or whether the sensor is just reading a "15 days lifespan" flag. > Increase in standard sensor life of Libre 2+ from 14 to 15 days is not recognised by xDrip+. Sensor runs for 15.5 days ... 

Should the sensor life increase to 15 or 15.5?

> Should the sensor life increase to 15 or 15.5?

the *standard* life declared by the vendor increased from 14 to 15. 

My n=1 experience was that xDrip achieved 15.5 days approximately (I think it expired in the night)

What is behind the uncertainty?  
We cannot change this to 15.5 and get reports that it should be 15 and not 15.5.

The core issue is that xDrip predicts the same life on a Libre 2+ as on a Libre 2, when we know it is one day longer.

A Libre2+ will outlast a Libre 2, even if it stops dead on the vendor's 15 days.

So if we are replacing like for like the update to xdrip needs to recognise a libre 2+ sensor is being used and use a 15 day duration length.

Yes. That's the key point of this issue.

Sensor ends with xDrip showing age of 15.5 days having given up predictions of end time.
A further consequence appears to be that after the 14.5 days have passed an NFC scan generates a "sensor expired" error which occurs continually when using a transmitter Bridge like MiaoMiao

Additional use case - Libre 2+ (UK) sensor works with patched Librelink v2.3 to xDrip "Patched app" input, Librelink 2.3 displays "Sensor ends in 15 days" xDrip+ displays "Ends in 13.9 days" ~45 minutes after sensor came on line 1h after starting.
